body: This Future verse was straight flow state Pop Smoke, Quavo and Future come together on “Snitching” from *Shoot for the Stars, Aim for the Moon*. Pop Smoke opens the track with his deep voice, while Quavo adds a melodic hook over the dark drill production. Then Future comes in and starts flowing at a completely different pace. He barely leaves any space between his bars, switching up his cadence while staying right on the beat. Allegations are not findings of guilt.

source_caption_text:
This Future verse was straight flow state 😤🔥

Pop Smoke, Quavo and Future come together on “Snitching” from *Shoot for the Stars, Aim for the Moon*. Pop Smoke opens the track with his deep voice, while Quavo adds a melodic hook over the dark drill production.

Then Future comes in and starts flowing at a completely different pace. He barely leaves any space between his bars, switching up his cadence while staying right on the beat.

Future’s verse is the part that really stands out. He gets into a zone and just keeps going, making the whole verse feel like one continuous flow without forcing it.

#future #hiphop #rap
